description: Pause or resume checks/delivery for the selected saved lead search, only when requested. Read updates first and pass the returned delivery revision and a stable retry key. Pause does not cancel subscription renewal. Resume cannot override a newer pause and requires valid entitlement and source checks.

action.description: Explicit requested delivery change: pause checks and delivery, or resume subject to entitlement and source checks. This never cancels subscription renewal.

expected_revision.description: Latest delivery_revision returned by gisdb_get_lead_updates. A stale value cannot override a newer pause or resume.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact request. Reuse it with identical arguments after an uncertain result; use a new key for changed arguments.

workflow_id.description: Exact account-owned workflow_id returned by the saved-search tools.

name: gisdb_set_lead_updates
